items.title: Presentation: Continuous Delivery for Foundational Platforms
items.blurb: Ian Nowland discusses why conventional CI/CD practices break down for stateful, core infrastructure.

items.title: Optimizing Kubernetes pods for reliability with topology spread constraints
items.blurb: Topology spread constraints let you determine how Kubernetes spreads pod replicas across failure domains, such as availability zones and regions.

items.title: Routeup – stable local HTTPS URLs and opt-in public tunnels
items.blurb: I built Routeup around a simple idea: local apps should use their real names. It was inspired by Portless , but I also wanted built-in public tunneling, selective path exposure, request inspection, and live logs.

items.title: Running a Java Spring Boot app on a 512 MB VPS with lightweight monitoring
items.blurb: I wanted to see how a fairly representative Java Spring Boot application behaves on a very small VPS, especially the difference between configured heap and actual JVM process memory.

items.title: Microsoft Moves AI Governance From Policy to Runtime Enforcement
items.blurb: Microsoft has outlined an AI governance architecture spanning nine governance domains and four functions: policy, control, visibility, and proof.
